decisions_made.decision: Handle a missing Tokio child ID as a launch error and request child termination instead of panicking.
decisions_made.rationale: The supervisor cannot establish tree ownership without a process ID. kill_on_drop provides a second child cleanup path. Tokio does not expose a way to inject the already-reaped state immediately after spawn, so this defensive branch has no direct behavioral test.

decisions_made.decision: Create Windows children suspended, assign their exact process handle to a kill-on-close Job Object, then resume the primary thread.
decisions_made.rationale: No child code can create descendants before job membership. Launch fails closed if job setup, thread lookup, opening, or resume validation fails. There is no PID-based fallback after job closure.

decisions_made.decision: Capture at most 64 KiB of raw bytes per line and append ...[truncated] to oversized lines.
decisions_made.rationale: The reader consumes the remainder through the newline without retaining it. The output marker makes truncation visible to callers.

decisions_made.decision: Stop and join stream readers after the five-second post-exit drain deadline, then close the receiver when Exited is delivered.
decisions_made.rationale: A descendant holding a pipe open cannot emit stdout or stderr events after the exit event.

decisions_made.decision: Accept item.started events only inside a turn and validate their nested item.type.
decisions_made.rationale: The Mac trace includes a command item.started event, which the old parser classified as an unknown terminal protocol error.

decisions_made.decision: Do not reformat unrelated files to clear the workspace formatting baseline.
decisions_made.rationale: The repo-wide formatter reports existing differences in untouched files. Every modified Rust file passes direct rustfmt checking.

decisions_made.decision: Use the readable Ponytail skill guidance without claiming its OMP/Pi extension is active.
decisions_made.rationale: The local package v5.3.3 is installed and its instructions are readable, but this Codex collaboration runtime has no Ponytail tool or Pi extension loader.
